_purpose: Prior-year development figures confirmed by two readings of the filing, for records whose adopted figure the extraction error-rate study (PLAN R213) found wrong and whose correct figure no extraction route produces. run_analysis.py (load_and_classify, apply_confirmed_figure) adopts the register's figure for these records only, before the basis and cohort decisions and before the FX conversion, discloses the correction in the record's data_quality_notes and _pyd_route, and keeps the record in the sample. figure_m is in millions of the report's own currency, like the record's *_gbp_m fields. figure_kind is 'triangle' (read from a printed triangle over the underwriting years up to t-2, so the cohort cutoff holds) or 'stated' (a figure the filing states). basis is the basis the readings established. The loader refuses an entry without two readings, its pages and a quote; an entry marked _to_complete is skipped, not applied, until it carries them.
